providers.market_view: At the exact 2026-10-23 cutoff, broad pre-cutoff scans highlighted multiple earnings reactions and volume surges that had already materialized into immediate price moves, leaving no qualifying common stocks with unspent forward catalysts suitable for 1-5 session longs under the independence and timing constraints.

Equity markets exhibit cautious sentiment as the Q3 earnings season continues alongside idiosyncratic regulatory developments in the biotechnology sector. While some megacap financial earnings have surpassed headline estimates, underlying growth metrics suggest a moderating pace of consumer spending. In the healthcare space, selective regulatory milestones provide binary catalysts, although significant ambiguity remains for candidates navigating non-traditional approval pathways. Qualitative market indicators suggest a consolidation phase as investors digest revised forward guidance ranges and upcoming central bank policy considerations.

The tape is fragile: AI-infrastructure leadership has cracked on capex-financing worries, and investors are discriminating between spending and returns ahead of a heavy earnings week and a Fed decision. Single-stock news, not broad risk appetite, is driving moves. I favor setups where the cutoff price has not absorbed a concrete fundamental upgrade, and I treat unconfirmed headline gaps as items to confirm rather than chase.

# AI雲端股跌慘空方賺翻！本月帳面獲利達60億美元
...
- 1.市場憂雲端、資料中心業者靠舉債擴AI基建難持續，相關股遭拋售。
- 2.ORTEX：CoreWeave、IREN、Nebius等5檔空單占流通股20%至26%，總放空市值約170億美元。
- 3.10月迄今空方帳面獲利約60億美元；Nebius獲利29.4億美元居首，CoreWeave近17億美元。

市場擔憂新型雲端與資料中心業者仰賴舉債擴建人工智慧(AI)基礎設施的模式難以持續，引發相關股票拋售潮。根據數據分析公司ORTEX統計，押注這些美國業者股價下跌的放空投資人，10月迄今已累計獲得約60億美元帳面獲利。

ORTEX數據顯示，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、IREN(IREN-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)、Applied Digital(APLD-US)與Core Scientific(CORZ-US)這五家公司的放空股數，占各自自由流通股數約20%至26%，顯示空方部位相當集中。

其中，CoreWeave目前放空比率為23.7%，高於月初的19.6%，也略高於2026年初的22.7%。隨著公司股價本月累計重挫近30%，放空投資人已獲得近17億美元帳面獲利。
...
不過，若拉長至今年以來，這些空方仍累計帳面虧損33.3億美元，顯示本月獲利尚不足以彌補先前損失。
...
ORTEX指出，目前這五家公司遭放空的股票總值約170億美元，且借券成本仍普遍偏低。隨著市場重新檢視AI基礎設施擴張所需的龐大資金與債務負擔，相關股票成為空方獲利的重要來源。不過，上述收益均為帳面數字，並不代表投資人已回補部位、實際落袋。
